score: abs(actual - frozen point prediction) / scale at that origin
calibration: all published product-windows with target end strictly before forecast origin; expanding pool across same 12 items
quantile: ascending score at one-based ceil((n+1)*0.9); no interpolation; unavailable if rank exceeds n
metrics: mean interval score: width + 2/0.1 * outside distance
stability: all 12 weekly origins for point errors; only same 8 eligible origins for interval metrics; worst window, win/tie/loss counts, all items retained
daily: point stability over 3 origins only; interval unavailable under four-window minimum; do not pool 28 correlated horizons as 28 independent origins
restrictions: No retraining, parameter selection, threshold search or edits to parent forecasts.
Temporal and cross-item dependence; model refits each origin; no exchangeability guarantee.
Original model selection used these same 12 windows; residual time filtering does not undo selection feedback.
90% is a nominal target, not single-SKU, simultaneous, future or business guarantee.
Later origins can use earlier evaluated labels only after their seven-day targets finish; report remains development replay.
